assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and all three KEY_AREA polygons are repository provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-sensitive metrics, figures and project locations require whole-chain recalculation after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green-ratio controls, setbacks, road redlines and statutory land use are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land use and intensity are conceptual design logic only, not approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, use, age, condition and ownership are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Conceptual footprints do not assert demolition, retention, renovation or construction feasibility.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, traffic counts, station interfaces and safety conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Mobility geometry is a conceptual connectivity network only.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection and construction-control zones are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Identity, landmarks and public-space elements require heritage review before siting.

assumptions.statement: Public-service, childcare, education, health, housing supply and municipal-capacity baselines are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Service nodes are system concepts, not capacity or eligibility commitments.
